message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if shifted) | Long‑Weekend Dates | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** | The holiday is observed on Monday, so the weekend is extended to Tuesday. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** | Only provinces that observe Family Day get this long weekend. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday itself is the holiday; the weekend is Friday–Sunday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** | National holiday; the weekend is Friday–Sunday. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** | The holiday is observed on Monday, giving a three‑day break. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** | National holiday; the weekend is Friday–Sunday. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** | National holiday; the weekend is Friday–Sunday. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** | Observed on Monday, giving a three‑day break. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** | The holiday is on Monday, so the weekend is Friday–Sunday. |

### Quick Reference (by month)

- **January** – Jan 1–3 (New Year’s Day)
- **February** – Feb 18–20 (Family Day in some provinces)
- **April** – Apr 7–9 (Good Friday)
- **May** – May 20–22 (Victoria Day)
- **July** – Jul 1–3 (Canada Day)
- **September** – Sep 2–4 (Labour Day)
- **October** – Oct 7–9 (Thanksgiving)
- **November** – Nov 11–13 (Remembrance Day)
- **December** – Dec 23–25 (Christmas Day)

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to support all provinces, you’ll need to add province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Family Day in British Columbia, etc.). The table above covers the nationwide long weekends that apply to every Canadian.
